what: Saved copy: 23 real rows from Grant Witness's NIH download, so the scraper and the demo work offline (GG_SCRAPE_SOURCE=saved, or automatically when the live download fails).
edits: Rows copied verbatim; the two long free-text columns (Grant Abstract, Public Health Relevance) were dropped to keep the file small. Rows were picked to cover every Detailed Status value, a supplement (S1) row, a grant listed both as a prime award and a supplement (U01CA267827), and a row whose full award number is N/A.
caveat: Grant Witness is a volunteer, advocacy-adjacent project that infers terminations and restorations from RePORTER, TAGGS, USAspending and court filings (https://grantwitness.org/nih/updates/methodology). It is one source among several, never the final word.
